visual.general_description: Color Doppler ultrasound image of the heart in a fan-shaped sector with a mosaic of blue, red, orange and yellow flow signals.
visual.detailed_description: Echocardiographic still image on a dark background. A larger grayscale ultrasound sector contains tissue echoes; inside it, a fan-shaped box outlined in white (the color Doppler region) holds a color overlay. In the lower center of the box a broad, irregular mosaic of yellow, orange, red and blue-green colors forms a jet-like pattern that narrows toward the upper right, where blue and red-orange color continues. Bright white curved echoes run along the lower and right edge of the image. A row of small white dots runs diagonally along the left edge of the grayscale sector. Printed text: "1,07 cm" in yellow at the upper left; small cross-shaped markers joined by a dotted line near the right of the color area; a small "x" with a chevron marker at the left of the sector; at the lower left a circled letter G, the letters P and R with a small triangle icon between them, and the numbers 1,6 and 3,2. No panel letters, arrows or text labels naming structures, and no names, dates or institution text are visible.
